pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions unless floating profit exceeds 2.0x ATR and the stop-loss is locked at break-even plus commission.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require 15-minute ATR to sit above its 20-period median and real-time spread to be under 1.5 pips prior to order authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Secure 50% position scale-out at +$5.00 float; trail remaining volume with dynamic Parabolic SAR (step 0.02, max 0.2).
